      • shiftEndAndAddEdge

        public void shiftEndAndAddEdge(WindowContext.ActiveWindow window,
                               long position)
        Shifts the end of a window and registers the new end as an additional slice edge. Unlike a ShiftModification, the slice edge at the old end is kept, as it may still be needed (e.g. as the end of a window that was split off) and as moving it could cross other slice edges.
